_comment_tickers: ACTIVE universe. The original sector-balanced midcap set, selected
WITHOUT reference to realised returns: two tickers per sector across
nine sectors, one each for Utilities and Real Estate.
This is the honest comparison universe and the one every Phase 14
finding is measured against — first-month-6 and every baseline figure
in the thesis-split spec (median hold, realised P&L, win rate) come
from these names. Equal-weight buy-and-hold over long-baseline-2025
returns ~+11.9% against SPY +7.8%, so the bot is being asked to beat
a roughly market-tracking basket rather than a runaway one.
Keep this set active for any before/after comparison against a prior
run. Swapping universes mid-investigation silently invalidates every

SELECTION CAVEAT: these names were chosen with hindsight — screened ON
their realised return over the very window they are backtested against.
Equal-weight buy-and-hold over that window returns ~+102%, so any
backtest on this universe measures the bot against an already-rising
basket and is NOT evidence of strategy skill. A P&L improvement here
cannot be attributed to any change in the bot.
It is kept because it is still useful for questions that do not depend
on absolute return — prompt-render shape, cache behaviour, throughput,
and anything measured per-decision rather than per-pound.
